user.title: Choose Log Export Backend
user.description: Select how you want to export Home Assistant system logs.

otel.title: Configure OTLP Endpoint
otel.description: Enter the connection details for your OpenTelemetry collector. A test log record will be sent to check the connection: "{validation_message}".

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the OTLP collector.
data_description.port: HTTP port of the OTLP collector (default 4318).
data_description.use_tls: Enable HTTPS for the connection to the collector.
data_description.encoding: Encoding format for the OTLP payload: json or protobuf.
data_description.batch_max_size: Maximum number of log records to buffer before flushing (1-10000, default 100).
data_description.resource_attributes: Optional comma-separated key=value pairs added to every log record (e.g. deployment.environment=production,service.namespace=home).
data_description.token_type: Authentication scheme: Bearer sends the token as-is; Basic base64-encodes it as 'username:password'.
data_description.token: Optional token. Sent in the 'Authorization' header.
data_description.headers: Optional extra HTTP headers in 'Name: value' format (e.g. stream-name: my-stream). Enter one header per entry.
data_description.path: Path appended to host:port for the logs endpoint (default /v1/logs). Prefix with any API-specific path (e.g. /api/otlp/v1/logs).

reauth_otel.title: Re-authenticate OTLP Endpoint
reauth_otel.description: Authentication failed. Enter a new token. A test log record will be sent to check the connection: "{validation_message}".

data_description.token_type: Authentication scheme: Bearer sends the token as-is; Basic base64-encodes it as 'username:password'. Raw Basic sends as configured. ApiKey sends with 'ApiKey' prefix.
data_description.token: New token to authenticate with the OTLP collector.

syslog.title: Configure Syslog Endpoint
syslog.description: Enter the connection details for your RFC 5424 syslog server.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the syslog server.
data_description.protocol: Transport protocol: UDP (fire-and-forget) or TCP (reliable delivery).
data_description.use_tls: Enable TLS encryption for TCP connections. Ignored for UDP.
data_description.app_name: The APP-NAME field in RFC 5424 messages (default: homeassistant).
data_description.facility: Syslog facility code used to calculate the PRI value (default: user).

common.title: Additional Home Assistant Events
common.description: Optionally subscribe to Home Assistant events beyond system log messages.

data.event_based_logging: Use System Log events in place of Python root logger
data.log_level: Minimum log level (root logger mode only)
data.log_ha_event_body: Serialize event data into log body

data_description.event_based_logging: Use standard Home Assistant log event as alternative to capture via Python root logger, limited to  warning and error logs available
data_description.log_level: Minimum severity forwarded to the remote endpoint. Only applies when root logger mode is active (system_log_event disabled). Default: INFO.
data_description.custom_events: Optional list of additional Home Assistant event names to subscribe to (e.g. zha_event). Enter one event name per entry.
data_description.log_ha_event_body: When enabled, the full event data is serialized as JSON into the log body. Only entity_id, domain, and service are retained as structured attributes.
data_description.suppress_system_log_event_name: When enabled, system_log_event records are exported without an eventName field. Disable when using remote_logger as a general event recorder so all event types can be distinguished.

data.log_ha_state_changes: Home Assistant state changes, without attributes or context

data_description.log_ha_lifecycle: Subscribe to homeassistant_start, homeassistant_started, and homeassistant_stop events.
data_description.log_ha_core_changes: Subscribe to component_loaded, core_config_updated, service_registered, service_removed, lovelace_updated, panels_updated, themes_updated, labs_updated, user_added, user_updated, and user_removed events.
data_description.log_ha_core_activity: Home Assistant core activity, including service calls, automation and script execution.
data_description.log_ha_state_changes: Home Assistant state changes (without attributes or context) and logbook entries
data_description.log_ha_full_state_changes: Home Assistant state changes (complete event) and logbook entries

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the endpoint. Verify the host, port, and TLS settings.
error.invalid_attributes: Invalid format. Use comma-separated key=value pairs (e.g. env=prod,region=us).
error.invalid_headers: Invalid format. Each entry must be 'Name: value' (e.g. stream-name: my-stream).
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the bearer token.
error.state_changes_exclusive: Select only one state change option.
